spectral.method: PDF cubic Bezier centerlines, inversion by monotonic x, 1 nm sampling
spectral.ordinate: Relative Sensitivity as printed; linear/log meaning unresolved
spectral.illumination: Wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2856 K)
spectral.missing: empty CSV field means outside plotted path; not zero sensitivity
spectral.uncertainty: Path extraction removes tracing error, not source measurement or interpretation uncertainty

characteristic.method: native 795x559 RGB image, black-ink vertical runs; no interpolation
characteristic.uncertainty: At least pixel/line-width quantization; no certified measurement accuracy. R/B unavailable when merged.
characteristic.identity: Right-edge labels establish Green upper, Blue middle, Red lower; unresolved crossings not assigned
